text:
maria_cs: Quick capture from three onboarding calls this morning — repeating asks, dropping raw bits so we can triage.

maria_cs: Key asks: 1) per-route billing breakdown in-console (Acme + NorthBay) 2) route-level opt-out for continuous batching (chat latency pain) 3) ability to pin embedding model per route/integration.

rahul_csm: Acme called out cost unpredictability as a renewal blocker (renewal ~5w). They want a per-route line-item or an export that maps requests -> invoice lines.

anya_eng: Tech note: we already emit per-request token usage and a batching flag. Building a per-route cost dashboard is more of an analytics + UI job; estimate ~1-2 sprints for an MVP export + chart.

eli_sre: For the batching opt-out, runtime change is small 1 (check route config before batching). Risk: disabling batching reduces throughput; need a safe rollout and telemetry to monitor cost delta.

sam_pm: Prioritize fast wins: (A) batching opt-out toggle (fast) (B) per-route billing export/dashboard (mid) (C) embedding-pin per route (long). Agree?

rahul_csm: Agree. I'll push this into renewal playbook: ask renewals to join next Acme call if we can show a timeline.

maria_cs: Can someone pull last 14d traces for acme-org including tokens, batching flag, latency_ms, and route tag? I want to surface 200 short prompts for quant/quality diffs.

triage-bot: @maria_cs created ticket CS-1490: "Acme: per-route billing + batching opt-out" and added label "renewal-risk".

eli_sre: Dropping two short sample logs from support ticket:
```
[2026-04-02T16:22:11Z] org=acme req=zz12 latency_ms=82 tokens=5 batching=on route=chat-main
[2026-04-02T16:22:12Z] org=acme req=zz13 latency_ms=410 tokens=8 batching=on route=chat-main
[2026-04-02T16:25:01Z] org=acme req=zz14 latency_ms=90 tokens=4 batching=off route=chat-main
```

anya_eng: I'll scope the opt-out flag and a simple telemetry dashboard to show batched vs unbatched tail latencies. Will propose a rollout plan to avoid regressing throughput.

sam_pm: I'll write a 1-pager impact estimate for product and attach CS-1490. If opt-out is low-risk we can target a fast spike this week.

maria_cs: Thanks all. I'll include customer quotes in the sync: "We can't explain spikes on our invoices" and "Batching kills our chat latency". Posting meeting notes after the GTM sync. :sparkles:
